title: AYE SALAAMI KHIYAAM JALTEY HAIN
body:
AYE SALAAMI KHIYAAM JALTEY HAIN
RUN MAY NAAMOOS-E-SHEH NIKALTHAY HAIN
<<DIVIDER>>
RUN MAY BAJTHAY HAIN FATHA KAY BAAJEY
DARR SEY BEYVOUN KE DUM NIKALTHAY HAIN
<<DIVIDER>>
BAITHI HAIN BIBIYAN ANDHERAY MEIN
SHAAMIYON MAY CHARAAG JALTHAY HAIN.
<<DIVIDER>>
ZERAY KHANJAR HAIN GARDANAY SHABBIR
MURTUZA GHAM SE HAATH MALTHAY HAIN
<<DIVIDER>>
QABR-E-ASGHAR SAY KAHTI THI BANU
AYE LAHAD HUM YAHAAN SAY CHALTHAY HAIN
<<DIVIDER>>
TU HAMAARI TARHA SE BEHLAANA
SHAB KO ASGHAR BAHOT MACHALTAY HAIN
<<DIVIDER>>
PEISH HAAKIM KHADEY HAIN AHLE HARAM
SAB KAY CHEHROUN PA ASHK DHALTHAY HAIN
<<DIVIDER>>
KHAINCHTAY HAIN GALEY SEY TEER HUSSAIN
MU SEY ASGHAR LAHU UGALTHAY HAIN
<<DIVIDER>>
ZAKHM JALTHAY HAIN GARM HAI JO ZAMEEN
SHAAHEY DEEN KARWATAIN BADALTHAY HAIN
